quest.title: Lucky Find
quest.description: Xiangling believes that Lotus Heads and Jueyun Chilis alone will not let her prevail in the cook-off, and sets off to find more ingredients.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x125, Mora x4650, Adventurer's Experience x2, Fine Enhancement Ore x5

talks.objective: Go to the place Xiangling mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Wh—What's that!?

talks.objective: Talk to Xiangling and the shivering man

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: Brr... So, so c—cold...

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: He's shivering! We need to warm him up, quick!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Make a fire!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Hot soup would be even better.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, how about I look after him while you make him a <color=#00E1FFFF>nice warm bowl of soup</color>?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: We passed a hilichurl camp on the way here. There'll almost certainly be a campfire there to cook on.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Great. Be as quick as you can!

talks.objective: Make a Delicious Radish Veggie Soup
Give the hunter the soup you prepared

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: Mmm... That is better... That is better...

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: Thank you. That soup really did the trick.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened, did you get frozen?

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: Yes. I was chasing a boar, and after chasing him all this way he slipped into those underground ruins over there.

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: I followed him inside, but ran into a Cryo Regisvine.

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: It froze me instantly. When I woke up I ran straight outside, but... I only made it this far before my strength failed me.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Cryo Regisvine? Vines... attack people?

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: They do now! I'd heard of them before from others, but this was the first time seeing one with my own eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yikes, we should definitely keep our distance from the ruins... It sounds dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: It sounds delicious!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: That's it! The missing ingredient! The icing on the cake!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Calm down. Can we really eat a tree that's that aggressive?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Only one way to find out — let's go!

response.speaker: Olaf
response.text: Do not worry about me, I'll be fine. But you must stop her, she is putting herself in grave danger.

choices.text: You should get back to Springvale.
Does anything NOT make you think about food?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: We passed a hilichurl camp on the way here. There'll almost certainly be a campfire there to cook on.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I'll stay here and look after him while you go and make him a nice warm bowl of soup.

dialogues.speaker: Olaf
dialogues.text: So cold... S—so c—cold in there...
